verdict.rationale: Raygun clearly ships its own client SDKs ('providers'): a user praises its open-source .NET and WinRT providers, the changelog describes an SDK-level SendInBackground queuing enhancement for .NET Core, and the docs reference a JavaScript language guide plus client-side filtering of sensitive data before errors are sent. However, the pack never shows an SDK catalog, install or API reference docs, or the breadth of supported languages, and the community comments about missing Python and JS support date from launch. missing for 10: documented list of official SDKs and languages, SDK installation/API reference docs, evidence of current multi-language coverage, independent recent hands-on corroboration.
